producers.title: Producers
producers.description: We work with a few families and cooperatives we know personally: growers who farm without chemicals, and the keepers of foods protected by Slow Food Presìdi.
producers.partnersBody: Small producers who belong to Slow Food Presìdi: they follow shared rules to keep a traditional food alive, and sell it at a fair price.

stories.title: Stories
stories.description: Where our wines and foods come from, and the people who make them.

hero.title: Wines that take their time.
hero.alt: A vineyard in the late afternoon
hero.lead: Lento means slow. We bring natural wines from small Italian growers, and foods kept alive by Slow Food Presìdi, to tables in the UK and Northern Europe — with the stories of the people who make them.

growers.title: Small growers
growers.body: Families farming a few hectares organically, by hand, in places they know stone by stone.

cellar.title: Nothing added
cellar.body: Native yeasts, no fining or filtering, and total sulphur below 50 mg/l — often far below.

presidi.title: Foods worth saving
presidi.body: Traditional foods from Slow Food Presìdi, bought directly at the price their makers set.

presidi.title: The pantry
presidi.body: Colatura from Cetara, Piennolo tomatoes from Vesuvius, cicerchia from the Marche hills: foods made in tiny quantities by people who refused to let them disappear.

trade.title: For restaurants, wine bars and shops
trade.body: Trade prices ex VAT, mixed cases and a pro-forma for every order. We deliver across the UK, Scandinavia, the Benelux, Germany, Austria and Ireland.
